Geographies Served Programs Old Age Care Programme The organisation has been supporting elderly individuals by providing them with ration materials and essential items to fulfil their basic needs. It also extends its assistance to bed-ridden elderly individuals by distributing daily meals. Nutrition/Meal Programme Both school children and Government school students are provided with nutrition support to enhance their overall health. They receive snacks on a weekly basis, either once or twice a week, to ensure they have access to nutritious food. Additionally, they are provided with daily meals to meet their dietary needs and promote their well-being.
